reproducibility_boundary.consequence: The primary environment is the closest date-bounded public reconstruction, not a claim about the authors' unrecorded exact environment. Failure to replay is reported as an environment/provenance boundary before it is interpreted as a physical failure.

modern_version_control.role: secondary compatibility sensitivity only after the primary replay passes; it cannot rescue a failed primary coordinate map

released_inputs.numpy_object_array_policy: do not load with allow_pickle=True; the chain, settings, images, and PSFs are sufficient for theory-neutral replay

coordinate_contract.Dolphin_interface_evidence: Dolphin v0.0.1 processor/data.py returns a deep copy of the full HDF5 dictionary as kwargs_data and processor/core.py passes it unchanged into lenstronomy's multi_band_list
coordinate_contract.scalar_field_treatment: record but never substitute for transform_pix2angle
required_checks: HDF5 image shapes equal the frozen settings sizes
HDF5 ra_at_xy_0 and transform_pix2angle equal the settings arrays bit-for-bit
every transform is finite, invertible, and round-trips pixel-to-angle-to-pixel to 1e-10 pixel
the released custom F435W mask equals the settings custom_mask bit-for-bit
every 61x61 PSF is finite, nonnegative, odd-sized, and normalized to 1 within 1e-6
image data, exposure maps, and background RMS values are finite, with positive exposure on retained pixels
the three-band coordinate dictionaries instantiate in the locked lenstronomy version without dropping or rewriting coordinate keys
coordinate_contract.stop_if: any operative coordinate field is ignored, rewritten, singular, inconsistent with its settings declaration, or cannot instantiate in the primary environment

required_checks: all samples and log likelihoods are finite
the HDF5 parameter names exactly equal the locked ModelConfig/Param nonlinear parameter order
the maximum-likelihood sample converts to kwargs without using the object-pickle NPY
the public settings produce PEMD plus SHEAR_GAMMA_PSI, six lens-light components, and six source-light components
a multi-linear forward solve at the stored maximum-likelihood nonlinear coordinates completes in all three bands

forward_replay_gate.nonlinear_parameters: fixed first at the stored maximum-likelihood sample; do not optimize them for the coordinate gate
forward_replay_gate.linear_parameters: solve with the released multi-linear source and lens-light model exactly as the locked software implements it
coordinate_controls: zero all ra_shift and dec_shift negative control
swap the F555W and F814W transforms negative control
forward_replay_gate.negative_control_requirement: each coordinate corruption must worsen the held-out pixel likelihood; otherwise the coordinate map is not empirically identified
forward_replay_gate.stop_if: the primary reconstruction cannot instantiate, parameter names disagree, the stored likelihood cannot be reproduced within both tolerances, predictive closure fails, or coordinate corruptions are not detected

execution_order: run the no-fit HDF5/config/mask/PSF/chain structural coordinate audit
download and checksum only Dolphin commit 1593c573541d26ae5791835430c68858988a969b
create the isolated Python 3.10 environment and verify exact package versions
instantiate the three released kwargs_data dictionaries without evaluating the lens model
verify the locked ModelConfig parameter order against the released HDF5 chain
evaluate the stored maximum-likelihood sample and multi-linear forward solution
run the held-out sectors and three coordinate corruptions
authorize the frozen lens-response Jacobian only if every replay gate passes

concrete_outcomes.advance: The primary date-bounded environment reproduces the declared coordinates, parameter order, likelihood, predictive images, held-out sectors, and detects every coordinate corruption. This authorizes only the already-frozen four-direction lens-response Jacobian.
concrete_outcomes.partial: If coordinate and predictive closure pass but the historical total-likelihood normalization does not, report both per-pixel residual closure and the exact provenance boundary; do not compute the Jacobian until the discrepancy is explained and a correction protocol is frozen.
concrete_outcomes.fail: Any parameter-order, coordinate, predictive, or negative-control failure stops J1402 lens promotion.
concrete_outcomes.rethink: A J1402 structural failure is the third consecutive external zero-promotion outcome after J0946 and E325 and triggers the frozen premise/data-requirement rethink.
